name: עָזָז
summary: A Reubenite, son of Shema and father of Bela, who lived in Aroer as far as Nebo and Baal-meon (1Ch 5:8). The name has the consonants of the verb עָזַז “be strong”; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “Bela son of עָזָז, son of Shema, son of Joel.”
The verb: “wisdom is strong (תָּעֹז) for the wise.”

note: BDB's p.bx.af, one token. It may be short for a name such as עֲזַזְיָהוּ “Yahweh is strong”.
